d: Mumbai City FC started strongly and took a 2-0 lead against Sporting Club Delhi at the Mumbai Football Arena. Muhammad Ajsal opened the scoring in the sixth minute before Zothanpuia doubled the advantage. SC Delhi responded through Carlos Fortes, with Akshat Mehra finding the equaliser in stoppage time. Juan Pena then scored a dramatic 90+4th-minute winner to complete a 3-2 victory for Sporting Club Delhi.
